shortDescription: On Holdings NYSE:ONON has brought Real Madrid star Kylian Mbappé on board as a brand ambassador and named French football legend Thierry Henry as director of football as it looks to challenge Nike NYSE:NKE and adidas OTC:ADDYY for a larger share of the lucrative European football market.Financial t…

children: has brought Real Madrid star Kylian Mbappé on board as a brand ambassador and named French football legend Thierry Henry as director of football as it looks to challenge Nike
for a larger share of the lucrative European football market.
Financial terms of the partnerships weren’t disclosed.
Mbappé, who comes to the Swiss sportswear company after 20 years with Nike

, will be outfitted with custom spikes made from the company’s Lightspray technology. Mbappé, along with other elite players from the sport, will work directly with On’s product teams to test, challenge, and refine future football products.
With its Lightspray technology—which uses robotics to spray the upper part of a shoe with filament—On Holdings
aims to create a shoe that is lightweight and flexible and mimics “second skin.”

“Football needs new ideas and a challenge to what is possible. When we enter a sport, we want to be the brand of the future—through true innovation and contemporary design. Our ambition is to bring On’s approach to the pitch, the pavement, and the runway—connecting elite performance with the culture that surrounds the game. With Kylian we have the perfect partner to dream what football can become,” On founder and co-CEO David Allemann said in a press release.
Mbappé’s signing is fueling a 5% gain in On Holding

title: On Holding scores big with Kylian  Mbappé , Thierry Henry signing
